name: Snowbasin
about: Real on-mountain facilities, researched for the 3D scenes. Lifts are keyed by OSM way id. Buildings carry lat/lon (the scene origin is not fixed yet). 'verified': false marks anything not confirmed by a lift database, the resort or a photo; colours are read from dated photos and are approximate hex. Buildings are placed by lat/lon (the resort's origin is not fixed yet); 'model' is the kit model drawn there, a landmark of its own where one was built from photos; lifts carry terminal_model, the maker's hood.
notes: OSM has all 13 lifts skiresort.info lists for Snowbasin; no real lift is missing from OSM.
Becker Express (Leitner-Poma quad, 2025-26) replaced the 1986 Stadeli Becker triple; OSM way 195798981 already follows the new alignment from the Wildcat base.
Wildcat Express (2017) replaced the Wildcat triple; Middle Bowl Express (2021) replaced a Thiokol triple. Porcupine is now the only fixed-grip chair.
No new lift announced for 2026-27 (a Dec 2025 roundup's 'Electric Horseman Express' belongs to Park City Mountain). Meadow Pavilion is being expanded for 2026-27.
The two unnamed OSM carpets are matched to Grizzly and Wildflower carpets by length only.
Lift colours are from liftblog photos dated 2015 (1998 Doppelmayr lifts), 2017-2020 (Wildcat, tram), 2022 (Middle Bowl), 2024 (DeMoisy) and Feb 2026 (Becker).

10203748.name: Wildcat Express
10203748.note: Snowbasin's first six-pack (2017), replaced the Wildcat triple. Uni-G-M stations: white hood with a green stripe along the bottom edge and dark glass roof panels; EJ-model chairs with DT grips, Chairkit loading gates, no carpet. Bottom beside Becker Express and Little Cat at the main base.

136016336.name: Needles Express Gondola
136016336.cabin_model: Doppelmayr/CWA 8-passenger cabin (1998 generation; exact model not confirmed)
136016336.note: From Earl's Lodge to Needles Lodge. Long 1990s Doppelmayr stations: white hood with a dark-green lower skirt and a continuous black window strip; bottom station fronted by a stone gatehouse, underground cabin parking; top station on a stone base with the drive vault below, beside Needles Lodge. Cabins pale grey-blue glass/upper body over a white lower panel with Snowbasin's yellow sun logo; a few cabins carry flag stripes. Same cabins and stations as Strawberry.

136016402.name: John Paul Express
136016402.note: Long HSQ (2,184 m in OSM) from the main base to John Paul Lodge; bottom terminal has underground chair parking and a small stone ticket/operator house beside it. Top station next to the Allen Peak Tram bottom. Built for the 2002 Olympic men's downhill/super-G access. Same white/dark-green 1990s hood as the gondolas.

136016424.name: Allen Peak Tram

color.cabin_flags: French, Austrian, Swiss, Italian etc. flags with names of Olympic downhill champions

136016424.note: Small 15-passenger tram (Doppelmayr 'Olympic Tram', 1998) from the John Paul Express top to Allen Peak, start of the Grizzly men's downhill. Short line (328 m in OSM). Cylindrical cabins: blue-tinted glass upper half, white lower band decorated with national flags and names of past Olympic downhill champions. Bottom station is a white/green 1990s Doppelmayr hood on a single concrete pier with steel stairs; top is a concrete drive/bullwheel tower. Originally towerless; a tower was added near the top in 2017.

195798979.name: Little Cat Express
195798979.note: Short beginner HSQ (skiresort: 'Littlecat Express') at the main base. Early Uni-G: white hood, green lower band, dark glass roof. Tower bases in 2015 photos are yellow-padded.

195798981.name: Becker Express
195798981.note: Opened 2025-26, replacing the 1986 Stadeli Becker triple on a new alignment; bottom moved beside Wildcat Express (Doppelmayr and LPA stations squeezed together). 1,800 p/h, ride under 7 min. LPA stations in Snowbasin colours: white hood with a green band, green arched end frames and a dark glass roof; 'BECKER' lettering. Austrian-made chairs, grey with black seats; grey towers with green bases. OSM way already follows the new alignment (bottom at the Wildcat base).

195798982.name: Strawberry Express Gondola
195798982.cabin_model: Doppelmayr/CWA 8-passenger cabin (1998 generation; exact model not confirmed)
195798982.note: Longest lift at Snowbasin (2,815 m in OSM). Bottom terminal sits inside the large Strawberry base building (tan walls, heavy pale log trusses, stone plinth) with automated cabin parking; exposed top terminal on a stone vault holding the drive motors, with a small operator cabin. Breakover/compression towers are triple-leg. Cabins as Needles: pale grey-blue with white lower panel and yellow sun logo.

195801396.name: Porcupine
195801396.note: Last fixed-grip chair at Snowbasin since Becker's replacement. Both terminals are enclosed in gabled chalet houses: brown vertical board upper walls, tan stucco lower walls, open drive-through bay for the chairs. Blue-grey chairs.

960196819.name: Middle Bowl Express
960196819.note: Snowbasin's first Leitner-Poma lift (2021), replaced a Thiokol triple on a slightly new alignment. LPA stations: white hood with a green band, green arched end frames, dark glass roof, 'MIDDLE BOWL' lettering. Austrian-made six-seat chairs, 90-degree loading at the bottom. OSM carries a leftover proposed:aerialway tag; the lift is built.

1125736587.name: DeMoisy Express
1125736587.note: Infill six-pack in the Strawberry area (2023), the only way out of that sector besides the Strawberry gondola; ends lower than the gondola top. LPA stations: white hood with a green band, green arched end frames, dark glass roof, 'DeMoisy' lettering.

1125736936.name: Grizzly Carpet
1125736936.note: Unnamed in OSM; 60 m at the main base by the Grizzly Center. Matched to skiresort.info's 60 m Grizzly Carpet by length and position, not confirmed by name.

1125736937.name: Wildflower Carpet
1125736937.note: Unnamed in OSM; 25 m at the main base. Matched to skiresort.info's 24 m Wildflower Carpet by length, not confirmed by name.

1214120404.name: Wildcat Handle Tow
1214120404.note: Handle tow near the Wildcat Express bottom (skiresort: 195 m; OSM 120 m). Added 2020 per news roundups; maker not found.

buildings.name: Earl's Lodge
buildings.style: Main base day lodge (about 45,000 sq ft) built by the Holding family for the 2002 Olympics: whole-log spruce frame, big exposed log trusses and gabled entry porticos, river-stone walls and tall stone chimneys, cedar-shake-style grey-brown roofs with several gables, tall mullioned timber windows. Two storeys plus a lower level (OSM). Needles Gondola leaves from its slope side; houses Earl's servery, Cinnabar and The Overlook.

buildings.name: Needles Lodge
buildings.style: Mid/upper-mountain restaurant at the Needles Gondola top (~8,700-9,300 ft, sources differ), tucked under the rock spires of the Needles. Heavy log post-and-beam frame with log gable trusses, rubble-stone walls and chimneys, grey shake hip/gable roof, tall timber-mullioned glass walls, big stone-walled terrace deck with umbrellas on the downhill side.

buildings.name: John Paul Lodge
buildings.style: Round/polygonal lodge at ~9,000 ft at the John Paul Express top and Allen Peak Tram bottom: stone base walls, ring of tall timber-framed windows, low conical shake roof topped by a small stone-and-timber cupola/chimney lantern; wraparound deck with glass rail. Named after John Paul Jones (died WWII).
buildings.note: Storey count read from photos, not confirmed. OSM footprint is 48 x 28 m, longer than a round plan; may include the deck/annex.

buildings.name: Grizzly Center
buildings.style: Guest-services building at the main base just east of Earl's Lodge: rentals (about 600 sets of skis), retail, tickets. 66 x 58 m footprint. Presumably in the same log-and-stone style as Earl's Lodge, but no clear exterior photo was found.
buildings.note: Use and location confirmed; exterior look not confirmed.

buildings.name: Strawberry base building (Strawberry Xpresso & Cafe / Strawberry Patio)
buildings.style: Bottom station building of the Strawberry Express Gondola, which runs straight through it, with automated cabin parking inside: tan/cream stucco walls, very heavy pale-varnished log trusses and columns carrying a broad gabled roof, stone plinth and stone-clad column bases, large mullioned windows; café with a sunny patio and fire pits.
buildings.note: OSM names it 'Strawberry Xpresso & Cafe'; the resort's dining page calls the outlet Strawberry Patio. Storeys estimated from photos.

buildings.name: Meadow Pavilion
buildings.style: Base pavilion near Earl's Lodge used for lunches, ski-school groups and meeting; expanded for the 2026-27 season. 33 x 20 m in OSM.

buildings.name: Needles Gondola gatehouse
buildings.style: Small square rubble-stone gatehouse with a hipped shake roof and an arched window, right beside the Needles Gondola bottom station and the John Paul Express bottom (stone ticket/operator house).
buildings.note: Not in OSM; lat/lon approximate (between the Needles and John Paul bottom stations). Seen in liftblog photos.

signature.name: Olympic downhill tram
signature.description: Tiny two-cabin Allen Peak Tram: cylindrical 15-person cabins with blue glass and a white band of national flags of Olympic downhill champions, climbing to the start of the 2002 Grizzly downhill.
signature.kit_note: No tram in the kit; needs a small round cabin model with flag decals and a single-pier bottom station.

signature.name: White-and-green 1998 Doppelmayr 'spaceship' stations
signature.description: Long rounded white hoods with a dark-green skirt and a black window strip on both gondolas and John Paul Express, often perched on stone bases.
signature.kit_note: gondola_station and terminal_detach exist; paint white with dark-green lower band, add stone plinth.

signature.name: Sun-logo gondola cabins
signature.description: Pale grey-blue 8-person cabins with a white lower panel and Snowbasin's yellow sun on Needles and Strawberry gondolas.
signature.kit_note: gondola (8 seats) exists; repaint and add sun decal.

signature.name: Green-trimmed LPA stations
signature.description: New Leitner-Poma stations (Middle Bowl, DeMoisy, Becker) in white with green arched end frames and green band, lift name in big letters.
signature.kit_note: terminal_detach exists; paint white/green with green end arches.

signature.name: Holding-era log and stone lodges
signature.description: Earl's, Needles and John Paul lodges: whole-log trusses, river-stone walls and chimneys, shake roofs and huge timber-mullioned windows; Needles sits under the rock spires, John Paul is round with a cupola.
signature.kit_note: base_lodge/restaurant exist but are plainer; need log-truss gables, stone chimneys and a round variant for John Paul.
